title: Eval signal fusion + alert aggregation for Console (Slack/PagerDuty integration)
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Background: We run continuous evals against production prompts and synthetic test suites. Currently Console surfaces individual regression signals and pushes separate alerts to Slack/PagerDuty which produces noisy incident storms during model/config rollouts. Goal: build a Console-integrated eval signal fusion layer and alert aggregation pipeline that groups related regressions, ties them to the triggering change (model version, config, rollout), and supports configurable delivery policies (Slack threads, single PagerDuty incident, or quieted rollouts). This ticket scopes the product requirements, rollout gating rules, and alert payload contract for engineering to implement.
acceptance_criteria: Console shows an aggregated eval incident view that groups regressions by root cause candidate (model|config|routing) within the last 30 minutes
Console adds a "Change Attribution" panel linking to the exact model version, config delta, or rollout IDs (links to GitHub/Console rollout) for each aggregated incident
Slack integration posts a single summarized message per aggregated incident with a thread for per-test details (configurable by team)
PagerDuty integration creates one incident per aggregated root cause with the ability to auto-close if downstream canary metrics are healthy
Alert cooldown and fingerprinting prevents >3 duplicate PagerDuty incidents for the same root cause within 2 hours
Documentation and runbook are published in Confluence and linked from Console incident detail
notes: Design/UX: show both aggregated summary and the underlying test-level deltas; surface confidence score for attribution
Product decision: default aggregation window = 30m, fingerprint by (model_version, config_hash, route, metric_group)
Policy: allow teams to opt-out to receive raw per-test alerts (useful for SREs)
Rollout plan: feature-flagged in Console; staged rollout to internal teams, then beta customers, then GA
Security: alert payloads must not include PII or full prompt content; link to redacted artifacts instead
